rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It is a nearly contemporaneous Cabinet-resignation letter with the same familiar salutation, an almost identical opening that acknowledges and accepts the resignation effective January 20, 1953, followed by personalized praise of the official's service, wisdom, and faithful discharge of duties. C14 is another close contemporaneous resignation-letter analogue, but its wording and sequence are less closely matched. C07 shares the general resignation-and-appreciation structure but is more remote in language and circumstances.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Dear Jess: I have your resignation as Postmaster General and I accede to your wishes, effective at the end of my term of office, January 20, 1953.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Dear Bob: I have your letter and I accept your resignation as Secretary of Defense, effective at the end of the President's term of office, January 20, 1953, as you desire.
shared_material.explanation: The openings use the same intimate salutation and nearly identical acceptance formula, office substitution, effective-date language, and acknowledgment of the recipient's wishes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have been fortunate to have you in my official family. Your mastery of every phase of operations in the postal service is outstanding in the history of the Department
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The splendid achievements of the Department of Defense in these last years must be attributed in large part to your vision and deep understanding
shared_material.explanation: Both move directly from accepting the resignation to attributing a department's achievements to the departing Cabinet officer's personal qualities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have valued your wisdom and guidance ... You gave all that was in you, unselfishly and loyally, to me and to the Government during my administration.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As we both prepare to leave office, I thank you for your devotion and your wisdom and your skill.
shared_material.explanation: Both close by emphasizing wisdom, devotion, and service to the President and government as the administration ends.
